ov: A small, long-tailed, seed-eating parrot of Australia. Wild budgies are green and yellow; captive breeding since the 19th century has produced blues, whites, yellows and greys.

why.dm: Budgies have been bred in captivity since the 19th century, and pet birds come in colours never seen in the wild.

fx: Wild budgies are nomadic, travelling in flocks in search of food and water.
notes: The existing fact (third most popular pet after dogs and cats) is confirmed word for word.
